excerpt: How this works Every human-written passage comes from Wikipedia, arXiv or Stack Exchange from the time before ChatGPT launched. The LLM paragraphs are generated from the same article titles, paper titles and questions as the human-written ones. Most frontier models (and some cheaper ones) as of late November 2026 are represented in the sample.
